details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2105-2108 (also scripts/ai_labels.py:158-161) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The label sync smoke step interpolates contract label names into an `::error::` workflow command without escaping CR/LF, and `_label_sync_name_validation_error` only checks length, so an injected workflow command is possible.
  WHY: The runner parses a name such as `bad\n::warning::...` as a separate workflow command; severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax) vs NIT (luna), highest used. sonnet-5_5 treated it only as a hardening suggestion.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2075-2110 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The smoke step accepts exit code 1 and ignores non-validate errors (e.g. `action=get`), so a total outage such as every label read returning 403 now passes CI, where it previously failed.
  WHY: This weakens the gate against the recommendation "have this CI smoke assert an empty errors array". Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT; highest used.
- analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md:1818 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The report says the existing text is `::error::Conflict resolver: …`, but the guards print `::error::Resolver scope <action> failed closed (<ExcClass>).` and `::error::Resolver attempt state unavailable or unsafe: ...`.
  WHY: A reader grepping logs for the quoted prefix will not find the guard failures. This is documentation only.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:569-575 (cited as 573 by gemini) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The prefetch fallback log reports `len(label_items)` (the whole contract) as the per-label GET count, but labels failing validation are skipped and never get a GET.
  WHY: The count is overstated, which misleads triage; there is no functional impact.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/ai_labels.py:`cmd_sync_labels` prefetch-unavailable log line | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The message reports `len(label_items)`, which overstates the real number of GETs because labels rejected by validation are skipped.
  WHY: The log line is misleading during triage; nothing else changes.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:"AI label sync dry-run smoke" step (`--dry-run > "${RESULT_JSON}" || SYNC_RC=$?`, `validation_failures` filter) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The step now accepts exit code 1 and any `action=get` or HTTP errors, and fails only on `validate` or 100-character-limit errors. A total outage now passes CI.
  WHY: The step is weaker than before and than the recommendation; the PR documents this as a deliberate trade-off.
- analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md:"Exec 2 / Reliability 1" row | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The guards print `::error::Resolver scope <action> failed closed (<ExcClass>).` and `::error::Resolver attempt state unavailable or unsafe: ...`, not `::error::Conflict resolver: …`.
  WHY: Documentation only; log greps for the quoted prefix will miss the guard failures.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Reliability 1 "Emit an enumerated RESOLVER_SCOPE_CHECK reason, action, attempt, allowed/changed-path counts, merge-state-changed flag, and agent exit class." | Expected change site: `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`, `_emit_scope_check_line` | Evidence of absence: The line carries `exc=` but no resolver agent exit code, and the report marks the recommendation "applied" without noting this. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/ci.yml, the `::error::` label-name print: label names are interpolated without escaping CR/LF (low risk). Fix: `" ".join(name.split())`.
- HARDENING: scripts/ai_labels.py `_prefetch_repo_labels`, `folded_name in label_map` branch: a casefold collision discards the whole prefetch; no fix needed.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2104-2110; scripts/ai_labels.py:158-161 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The smoke step builds an `::error::` command from contract label names. `_label_sync_name_validation_error` enforces only a 50-character cap, so CR/LF, `::warning::` or `%0A` in a name passes through and is interpolated verbatim.
  WHY: The runner parses an injected line as a separate workflow command. The repo escapes this elsewhere (`gh_helpers.sh`, `review_apply_fixes.sh`, `claude_pool_token.sh` and others), so this is the only unescaped sink.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2075-2092, 2095-2103 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The smoke step accepts exit code 1 and ignores any `errors` entry whose `action` is not `validate` and whose message lacks "100-character limit". Before this change it asserted an empty errors array.
  WHY: A transport outage producing only `action=get` errors now passes CI. This is narrower than the source recommendation ("have this CI smoke assert an empty errors array"), and the relaxation is a design choice the PR does not surface.
- analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md:1818 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The row quotes "The existing `::error::Conflict resolver: …` text", but the guards print `::error::Resolver scope <action> failed closed (<ExcClass>).` (review_conflict_resolve.sh:1352) and `::error::Resolver attempt state unavailable or unsafe: ...` (review_conflict_resolve.sh:1994).
  WHY: A grep for the quoted prefix will miss the new diagnostics and may suggest `RESOLVER_SCOPE_CHECK` is missing; the changelog and agents fragments quote the correct prefixes.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:569-575 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "label list prefetch unavailable" line logs `len(label_items)`, the full contract count, though GETs are issued only for labels that passed validation.
  WHY: The count is overstated and the message appears even when zero GETs follow; it is a diagnostic issue only.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "validate lengths locally before issuing reads, and have this CI smoke assert an empty errors array" (analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-30-2.md, Reliability item 2) | Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, "AI label sync dry-run smoke" step (around lines 2075-2110) | Evidence of absence: The step filters `errors` to `validate` and "100-character limit" (lines 2095-2103), tolerates exit code 1 (line 2085) and skips other failures. No test asserts the empty-errors contract. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Emit an enumerated RESOLVER_SCOPE_CHECK reason, action, attempt, allowed/changed-path counts, merge-state-changed flag, and agent exit class — without raw paths or exception text" (analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-30-2.md, Reliability item 1) | Expected change site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh, the two `_resolver_scope_state` and `_resolver_attempt_state` heredoc emitters (around lines 1182-1235 and 1812-1873) | Evidence of absence: The line carries `guard=`, `action=`, `reason=`, `exc=`, `attempt=`, `allowed_paths=`, `changed_paths=` and `merge_state_changed=`, but no resolver agent exit class field. The report at line 1818 marks it "applied". | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/ci.yml:2104-2110: replace `", ".join(failing_labels)` with `", ".join(repr(name) for name in failing_labels)`, or print one `::error::` line per label through `_sanitize_log_detail` (scripts/ai_labels.py:169-170). 1-3 lines.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
